# Megaphone

![Megaphone](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/megaphone.png)

Heads: 2 points, and the next 2 coins pay double.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 45%
- **Shop price:** 20 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 2 points, Next 2 coins pay x2

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Trader](characters-trader)
